subject: rearrangement number
statement: The paper proves that rr < non(M) is consistent with ZFC.

subject: rearrangement number
statement: The paper proves that max{cov(N),b} < rr is consistent in a forcing extension.

subject: free Hilbert algebras
statement: The paper gives a generic construction of n-generated free Hilbert algebras and Brouwerian semilattices by a uniform method applicable to any variety.

subject: linear Hilbert algebras
statement: The paper obtains a closed formula for the free spectrum of linear Hilbert algebras.

subject: bounded trees
statement: The paper identifies a sufficient condition under which certain trees that are not bounded can be elementarily embedded in trees that are bounded.

subject: tree operations
statement: The paper proves Feferman-Vaught style preservation properties for tree operations defined on bounded and unbounded trees.

subject: bi-intuitionistic logic
statement: The paper provides analogous results to the Goldblatt-Thomason theorem for axiomatisability in bi-intuitionistic logic.

subject: bi-intuitionistic logic
statement: The paper establishes a Lindstrom theorem for propositional bi-intuitionistic logic.

subject: Student-Teacher game
statement: The paper constructs for every totally ordered tree T a valid prenex formula such that every Student-Teacher game for the formula contains T as a substructure.

subject: Herbrand disjunctions
statement: The paper shows that minimal trees in the Student-Teacher game can be arbitrarily complex in terms of tree structure.

subject: hypergraph regularity lemmas
statement: The paper proves that (k+1)-uniform hypergraphs definable in an NIP strongly k-distal structure satisfy a homogeneous regularity lemma.

subject: k-strong honest definitions
statement: The paper introduces k-strong honest definitions and shows that an NIP structure is strongly k-distal if and only if every formula has a k-strong honest definition.

subject: quasi-boolean algebras
statement: The paper proves that the inclusion Q(F_3(X)) ⊆ Pa^-_3 is proper.

subject: p-algebras
statement: The paper proves that Mod(qb_3) is not generated by free p-algebras.

subject: inference-behaviour semantics
statement: The paper finds semantic clauses for exactly 21 meaningful connectives among 10,816 possible connective rule pairs in two-dimensional sequent calculi.

subject: intuitionistic vs classical connectives
statement: The paper shows that intuitionistic negation, disjunction and implication each capture half of the meaning of their classical counterparts.

subject: unitary groups
statement: The paper proves a variant of Ulam stability for unitary groups in tracial reduced products.

subject: homomorphisms of unitary groups
statement: The paper proves a classification of almost surjective continuous homomorphisms between finite dimensional unitary groups.

subject: reduced product isomorphisms
statement: The paper shows that all isomorphisms of product form of tracial reduced products are induced by almost permutations of coordinates and coordinatewise automorphisms.

subject: model companions
statement: The paper shows that the model companion of an endomorphism has NATP whenever the base theory T does.

subject: bialgebras
statement: The paper introduces signature pairs and bialgebraic theories providing a uniform language for constructing internal bialgebras in 2-categorical settings.

subject: internal bialgebras
statement: The paper constructs for every bialgebraic theory T and Σ-model M within a 2-category the object M^T of internal T-bialgebras.

subject: bialgebras
statement: The paper extends the classical Induced Functor of Algebras Theorem to lifting of lax monoidal functors to categories of internal monoids.

subject: fundamental logic with preconditional
statement: The paper proves strong completeness of fundamental propositional logic with preconditional with respect to a purely relational semantics.

subject: fundamental logic with preconditional
statement: The paper establishes the finite model property and decidability for extensions T and F of fundamental logic with preconditional.

subject: preconditional
statement: The paper develops full and faithful translations of fundamental logic with preconditional into ortho-S4 and intuitionistic KTB.

subject: group chunks
statement: The paper formulates a group chunk theorem in the context of sheaves on sites that generalizes results in model theory and algebraic geometry.

subject: partial morphisms
statement: The paper shows that a presheaf of partial magmas on a small category admits a universal morphism to a group.

subject: Gödel completeness theorem
statement: The paper gives a self-contained proof of Gödel's completeness theorem entirely within the formalism of first-order Boolean doctrines.

subject: Boolean doctrines
statement: The paper shows that Gödel's completeness theorem entails the fiberwise Stone dual of a first-order Boolean doctrine is its type space functor.

subject: Post complete conditional logics
statement: The paper identifies all of the finitely many regular and normal Post complete conditional logics.

subject: conditional logic extensions
statement: The paper proves analogues of Makinson's embedding theorems for Post complete extensions of conditional logics.

subject: conditional logics
statement: The paper shows that certain basic conditional logics have uncountably many Post complete extensions with relaxed closure properties.

subject: fat-shattering dimension
statement: The paper proves function-theoretic analogues of Hodges' quantitative result on extracting order property from 2-trees coded in binary relations.

subject: sequential fat-shattering
statement: The paper proves an at most double-exponential bound on dual sequential fat-shattering dimension.

subject: stable regularity lemmas
statement: The paper proves quantitative stable regularity lemmas for binary real-valued functions extending work of Malliaris and Shelah.

subject: analytic symmetry
statement: The paper develops an analytic symmetry lemma giving a function-theoretic analogue of density closeness for good sets in stable graphs.

subject: topological pressure
statement: The paper develops a Kolmogorov complexity point-to-set principle framework for upper and lower topological pressure and BS dimension in dynamical systems.

subject: Bowen pressure equation
statement: The paper proves a pointwise version of the Bowen pressure equation for dynamical systems.

subject: σ-coherent logic
statement: The paper proves completeness of countable σ-coherent theories for both propositional and predicate logic.

subject: σ-coherent theories
statement: The paper shows that each σ-coherent theory determines a quasi-Polish space or category of models where formulas correspond to continuous functions or functors.

subject: FIN_k hierarchy
statement: The paper shows that the FIN_k finiteness hierarchy collapses and every level is equivalent to H-finiteness.

subject: Ramsey-theoretic finiteness
statement: The paper introduces finiteness classes RRT-Fin^m_n and CRT-Fin arising from Rainbow Ramsey and Canonical Ramsey theorems in choiceless set theory.

subject: finiteness classes
statement: The paper proves that RRT-Fin^m_n and CRT-Fin are contained in the Dedekind finiteness class D-Fin.
